Claude Code MCP server: merge into ~/.claude.json (user) or <project>/.mcp.json (project)
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "mairc": {
      "command": "/opt/mairc/bin/mairc",
      "args": [
        "stdio"
      ]
    }
  }
}
Claude Code hooks: merge into ~/.claude/settings.json (user) or <project>/.claude/settings.json (project)
{
  "hooks": {
    "SessionStart": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "/opt/mairc/bin/mairc hook --client claude",
            "timeout": 5
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "UserPromptSubmit": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "/opt/mairc/bin/mairc hook --client claude",
            "timeout": 5
          }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "PostToolUse": [
      {
        "hooks": [
          {
            "type": "command",
            "command": "/opt/mairc/bin/mairc hook --client claude",
            "timeout": 5
          }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
Other agent CLIs:
MCP (stdio): /opt/mairc/bin/mairc stdio
Hook (any event, zero output when nothing is new): /opt/mairc/bin/mairc hook --client plain
